ns2:section.sectionText: Section C is offered in a self-paced, online format. Students registered for section C should access the course's Compass site before January 18 for further information about the course requirements and procedures. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.illinois.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
